title: Reduce public portfolio ambiguity and duplicate canonical ownership
outcome: Move every public repository toward retain, consolidate, private incubation, archive, or retirement using reversible evidence gates and zero broken references.
non_goals: Deleting repositories before package, release, installer, webhook, domain, and dependency references are cleared.
Using repository count alone as a success metric.

workstreams.responsibility: Maintain disposition records, retirement procedure, drift evidence, and portfolio exit criteria.
Receive non-duplicative coding adapter, fixture, and workflow value from legacy coding repositories.
Retain canonical brand-profile authority during design-system consolidation.
Remain a specimen lab and consume Brand without claiming production authority.
Own production UI/mobile behavior and evaluate overlapping product experiments.
Receive accurately named documentation retrieval ownership where appropriate.

exit_criteria.statement: Every public repository has a reviewed lifecycle and disposition.
No public canonical domain has more than one owner.
Each consolidation preserves licenses, provenance, issues, releases, and useful history.
Each archive or retirement passes the reference, package, release, installer, domain, and rollback gate.
No visibility change, archive, transfer, or deletion occurs without explicit authorization and recorded evidence.
Generated portfolio and live GitHub inventory agree.

authority_boundary: This initiative coordinates responsibility and evidence. It does not grant protected identity, authorization, runtime, persistence, release, publication, or GitHub-administration authority.
